name: Spirit Cafe
source:
Spirit Cafe is a visual novel where you play Charon, the ferryman of the dead from Ancient Greek mythology. Your job is to console the newly arrived dead on their way to the afterlife. Charon receives trophies as a reward for helping the freshly arrived spirits. The spirits of the dead are from the modern day, and they are just as surprised to find most of their beliefs proven wrong.

[from [url=https://violationthefirst.itch.io/spirit-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Spirit Cafe》是一部让你扮演古希腊神话中亡灵摆渡人卡戎的视觉小说。你的工作，是安慰那些初来乍到、即将前往来世的亡者。帮助新到的亡灵后，卡戎会获得奖杯作为回报。这些亡灵来自现代，发现自己生前的大部分信念都被证实有误时，也同样大感意外。

[摘自[url=https://violationthefirst.itch.io/spirit-cafe]itch.io[/url]]
